note: Reported by the outgoing manager handoff (docs/claude/work/handoffs/2026-11-04-01AFoLuH-to-new.md, PR #23007): no funding settlement for bybit_2 in 24h. MEASURED: settlements 11-04 16:00Z (SOL, ETH), 11-05 00:00Z and 08:00Z (ETH); 2 in last 24h; newest age 12.0h. Original claim (nothing settled in 24h) REFUTED. (b) exchange_funding (daily puller) newest row 11-03 08:00Z, last insert 11-03 08:27, while txn log has later SETTLEMENTs: that store lags ~2 days (feeds offline cost sweep funding attribution); timer active, cause not found.
